Images and Fonts Used

You can use the following path for images:

| Image | Path (for CSS) | URL |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background Image | /images/learn-css/paper-background.png | https://app.programiz.pro/images/learn-css/paper-background.png |
| Criminal Portrait (Jack Sparrow) | /images/learn-css/jack-sparrow.png | https://app.programiz.pro/images/learn-css/jack-sparrow.png |

The font used in the poster is Old Standard TT . You can use this font by using the following code in the <head> section of your HTML file:

```css
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Old+Standard+TT:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

It's fine if you don't get the spacing between elements exactly right. It can be difficult to guess just by looking at the image.
